scope: Original SQL table/query macros extracted verbatim; Python SQLite in-memory only, fabricated identical digest for different-length extents. Not a demonstrated XXH collision or upstream C/SQLite runtime qualification.

schemas.CREATE_TABLE_CONFIG: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS config(keyname TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, keyval BLOB, UNIQUE(keyname));
schemas.CREATE_TABLE_FILES: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, filename TEXT NOT NULL, ino INTEGER, subvol INTEGER, size INTEGER, mtime INTEGER, dedupe_seq INTEGER, digest BLOB, flags INTEGER, UNIQUE(ino, subvol), UNIQUE(filename));
schemas.CREATE_TABLE_EXTENTS: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS extents(digest BLOB KEY NOT NULL, fileid INTEGER, loff INTEGER, poff INTEGER, len INTEGER, UNIQUE(fileid, loff, len) FOREIGN KEY(fileid) REFERENCES files(id) ON DELETE CASCADE);
schemas.CREATE_TABLE_BLOCKS: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS blocks(digest BLOB KEY NOT NULL, fileid INTEGER, loff INTEGER, UNIQUE(fileid, loff) FOREIGN KEY(fileid) REFERENCES files(id) ON DELETE CASCADE);

query: select extents.loff, len, poff FROM extents join files on files.id = extents.fileid where files.id = ?1 and (1 = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM extents as e where e.digest = extents.digest));
